# VELTARO LABS — Pilot scope & acceptance template
**Status:** Draft research-scoping aid, NOT an approved service agreement, legal contract, invoice or engineering certification.

## A. Customer discovery (internal/private record)
- Opportunity ID: [private CRM identifier, no identifying client details in GitHub]
- Customer segment and budget-owner role: [confirm privately]
- Recent problem, current workaround and estimated cost of delay: [source / interview date]
- Lawful basis/permission for holding notes: [privacy review status]
- Buyer success criterion: [measurable]

## B. Proposed non-regulated desk-study scope
- Research question: [one sentence]
- Specific decision this brief should inform: [one sentence]
- Allowed sources/data: [public sources or contractually approved material only]
- Assumptions, constraints and geographical/regulatory context: [label every estimate]
- In scope: public-source literature review; requirements map; assumptions and evidence register; high-level comparison; uncertainty and next-study priorities.
- Out of scope: legal opinion, airworthiness/safety certification, professional engineering signoff, flight planning, physical tests, industrial drawings, guaranteed performance, safety-critical decisions.
- Required specialist review and professional credentials: [named and verified privately, or NO-GO]

## C. Draft deliverables and testable acceptance
- PDF/Markdown report: 6–10 pages, with dated sources and explicit limitations (length is adjustable by agreement).
- Evidence and assumptions table: source, date, claim, confidence, unknowns, reviewer status.
- A reproducible comparison table/model where safely within professional competence.
- A ranked list of three next tests/research questions.
- Optional single 30-minute results walkthrough.
- Client acceptance criterion: source traceability, scope completed, uncertainty disclosed, agreed format; **never promise physical feasibility**.
- Review/feedback method: [written sign-off and one bounded revision window, if contractually agreed].
- Delivery timeframe: [agreed only after capacity/cost validation].

## D. Commercial and compliance release gates
- [ ] Buyer confirms need and budget/approval authority.
- [ ] Founder verifies sufficient technical competence; qualified reviewer if needed.
- [ ] Legal entity/invoicing ability confirmed by qualified local accountant/lawyer.
- [ ] Contract, confidentiality, ownership, payment terms, cancellations, liability limits and scope exclusions reviewed.
- [ ] GDPR/controller/processor/retention decisions in place; no client secrets in public GitHub or public intake.
- [ ] Proposed price: [€___ before applicable VAT; internal pricing hypothesis until lawfully quoted].
- [ ] Direct delivery cost and estimated hours: [___].
- [ ] Founder approves spend and execution explicitly.

**No paid work starts unless all mandatory gates are actually cleared.**

## E. Post-delivery evidence
- Actual delivery/acceptance date: [private record]
- Actual staff/reviewer hours and direct costs: [private record]
- Invoice/payment status: [private financial system]
- Was the buyer problem solved within the limited scope? [verbatim feedback with permission]
- Repeat purchase/intro requested? [confirmed separately]
- Consent for public anonymized case study? [yes/no, recorded privately]
- Data deletion/retention next review: [date]

**Do not publish client names, emails, personal data, contracts, invoices, confidential findings or internal payment details in this public repository.**
